family_reports.body: The family judicial system has actively participated in parental abuse and alienation, gone with the money, neglected the needs of my young child, and negatively impacted not just my immediate family, that includes siblings of the child this suit is affecting, but has out-poured into extended family and our community. Irreparable harm has been done to my baby girl’s psychological, physical, mental, and emotional well-being; the court system has allowed physical and mental abuse, emotional neglect, coercion and manipulation, and they do it with a smile on their face, to protect the parent who provides a socio-economic benefit to the lawyers, amicus attorney, GAL, and judge, and neglected to protect the child, as is their DUTY. They should all be behind bars.

There are serious concerns about how Karl Hays and his appointed GALs such as Tahlia Stewart approach these cases. It often feels as though reports of abuse are met with skepticism rather than careful consideration, and that the legal process is being shaped to fit a specific narrative rather than the full set of facts. It is deeply troubling to see any position of authority used in a way that could undermine trust in the process.

My experience within the family court system was nothing short of a living nightmare. During a global pandemic, my children were taken from me, and my parental rights were suspended “until further order of the court.” I felt completely alone, with nowhere to turn, and was forced to cease all communication with my children this lasted for almost 2 years. The emotional toll including the stress, anxiety, and anguish has had lasting effects that I continue to carry with me to this day. I’ve lost years that I will never get back. I can’t help but think, “This should have never happened. We didn’t deserve this.” When I pictured raising my family, this is not how I envisioned it. Now, after an long drawn out battle I only see my children every other weekend, and it often feels like I’m watching someone else raise them. It is truly heartbreaking.
A 6 year old has been diagnosed with PTSD and severe trauma, due to Karl hays not paying attention or acting in the best interest of the CHILD. Our family has been broken for 5.5 years.
Completely took the side of the mother without giving me a chance to give my side of the story. Mother has lied on multiple affidavits and under oath in court multiple times.
This has cost me money, my health, my children.
